name: jev-context-replace
description: Replaces Claude Code's model-written compaction summary with a local outline plus excerpts from the jev-context log, so the model keeps only what the task needs. One click to turn on or off. Off by default.

python.title: Python for the server
python.description: Same as the jev-context mod: the Python that has jev-toolkit-compiler and jev-toolkit-usage installed. Empty: JEV_PYTHON, else `python` (Windows) or `python3` on PATH.
